result:
If I could change the world in one way, I’d make understanding the default.

Not perfect empathy, because that’s impossible. But something like this: every person would be able to feel, at least roughly, what another person is going through before reacting to them.

So when someone yells, you’d feel why they’re afraid.  
When someone ignores you, you’d feel why they’re withdrawing.  
When someone says something cruel, you’d feel the wound behind it.  
When someone says “I’m fine,” you’d feel that they aren’t.

I’d change the world so that people could see each other more clearly—not to remove conflict, but to stop so much suffering from coming from simple misunderstanding.

Most wars, cruelty, loneliness, and resentment aren’t created by pure evil. They’re created by people feeling unseen, unheard, or misunderstood. If that changed, everything else would change too.
